subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this token-bound index-callback branch the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit /model picker issue, or choose a competing open fix PR?
rationale: Both this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 target the same still-open issue with real behavior proof, and the remaining exact-head QA failure needs human interpretation rather than a line-level automated repair.

options.title: Use This Branch After QA Smoke Rerun
options.body: Prefer this PR because it preserves existing name-based callbacks, adds a token guard for stale index drift, and already has visible Telegram proof; rerun or inspect the failed Telegram QA shard before merge.

options.title: Choose The Competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 only if maintainers explicitly prefer replacing the callback format despite its broader compatibility risk.

options.title: Keep Both Paused
options.body: Leave both PRs open until a maintainer decides the permanent Telegram callback contract and owns the duplicated review cost.

recommendation.title: Use This Branch After QA Smoke Rerun
recommendation.body: Prefer this PR because it preserves existing name-based callbacks, adds a token guard for stale index drift, and already has visible Telegram proof; rerun or inspect the failed Telegram QA shard before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram runtime history and release carry-forward make this the best available owner for the canonical-fix and QA-smoke decision.
